content.value: Gathering XP is the experience system that drives World Tree progression. Instead of killing monsters, you earn World Tree points by performing gathering activities throughout the world.

• Mining — Breaking stone, ore, and mineral blocks. Rarer ores give significantly more XP.
• Woodcutting — Chopping trees. Larger trees and rarer wood types yield more XP.
• Fishing — Catching fish and treasure items. Treasure catches give bonus XP.
• Farming — Harvesting crops. Fully grown crops give full XP; breaking early gives reduced XP.
• Exploration — Visiting new chunks and discovering structures grants discovery XP.
Several World Tree nodes boost your XP gain rates for specific activities. Stack these nodes to accelerate your World Tree progression in your preferred gathering style.
Gathering XP is tracked per-player and persists across sessions. Your progress is never lost, even if you die.
